text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government takes strict measures to ensure the continuity of studies in unversities. It decided to put an end to harassment of Moslem fundamentalist students on the campus.
- Morocco present at the international agriculture exhibition of Berlin.
- King Hassan presides at a religious ceremony on the occasion of the 37th anniversary of King Mohammed V's death.
- Three Moslem fundamentalist students to appear on Tuesday before a Casablanca tribunal on charges of "disturbing the public order."
- A group of 80 clandestine immigrants, including Moroccans, were arrested by Italian police at Lampedusa port.
- Taxi drivers end their three-week strike.
- Trade unions urge the government to continue dialogue on social issues.
